data: Is the performance of the blue line in the left graph consistently higher than the dashed black line?

The blue line represents the performance of the models trained on different data sizes, while the dashed black line represents the performance of the random model. The caption states that all our models significantly outperform a random model. 

In the left graph (a), the blue line (Our models) is consistently above the dashed black line (Random model). This indicates that the performance of the blue line is higher than the dashed black line across all data sizes. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes, the performance of the blue line in the left graph is consistently higher than the dashed black line.
